The '''Overrun Volcanology Lab''' was a volcanology [[Laboratory/Legends|laboratory]] located on [[Kessan's Landing]], an island on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], used by [[Geologist/Legends|geologists]] to monitor the volcanic activity of [[Mount Felo]]. The lab was overrun by [[Mantellian Savrip/Legends|Mantellian Savrips]] during the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR:VD" />
